seo.title: Speaking | Priya Raghavan
seo.description: Keynotes and working sessions on executive authority for conferences, private offsites and portfolio events. From $35,000.

blocks.heading: A ninety-minute working session disguised as a keynote.
blocks.subheading: Audiences leave having scored their own authority gaps, not having watched someone describe theirs. No slide is longer than nine words.

background.alt: Priya Raghavan speaking to a full auditorium

blocks.heading: Three talks, each built for a specific room
blocks.subheading: Every talk is rebuilt against your audience before delivery. The structure holds; the examples change.

topics.title: The Quiet Authority
topics.description: Why the most capable person in the room is so often the least known outside it, and what the four-pillar alternative to louder self-promotion looks like in practice. The core talk, and the one most events book.
takeaways: The difference between exposure and standing, and why only one compounds
A live diagnostic across the four pillars every attendee completes in the room
The three failure modes that waste most executive branding budgets

topics.title: Your Expertise Is Not a Position
topics.description: Firms sell expertise; buyers cannot evaluate expertise. This session covers how to convert what your people know into positions the market can compare, choose between and repeat accurately.
takeaways: Why accurate self-description is the most common commercial error in advisory
How to name a method without inventing jargon
A workable process for making partner-level judgement portable

topics.title: The Referenceable Leader
topics.description: A team-level session on aligning individual authority with company narrative, so that senior leaders reinforce rather than compete with each other in market. Usually run as a half-day.
takeaways: How to divide narrative territory across a leadership team
The company-versus-individual authority tension, resolved deliberately
A ninety-day plan each leader leaves the room holding

blocks.heading: What you get when you book

items.title: A rebuilt talk
items.description: Two preparation calls, including one with three of your attendees, so the examples are drawn from your industry rather than mine.

items.title: Zero admin friction
items.description: Press kit, headshots, bio in three lengths, AV requirements and a signed contract within two business days of confirmation.

items.title: Something to keep
items.description: Every attendee receives the scored diagnostic and a follow-up note two weeks later, which measurably improves event feedback scores.

testimonial.quote: Highest-rated session of the conference, and the only one attendees were still quoting at dinner. She rebuilt the whole talk around our industry after one call with three delegates.
testimonial.author: Helena Fischer
